__instructions: Template for a Chapter Study document. Replace every <...> with real content. Every field is REQUIRED. 'scripture' must contain EVERY verse of the chapter with the EXACT World English Bible text from sources/bible/<book>-<ch>.json. 'words' on a verse is optional — include it only where a key Hebrew word occurs in that verse; every Strong's number must exist in sources/lexicon/strongs-hebrew-dictionary.js.
chapterTitle: <e.g. The Prophet's Complaint and the Astonishing Answer>
themeTitle: <quoted phrase, e.g. When God's Answer is Harder Than the Problem>

scripture.understanding: <1-3 sentences: what this verse is actually saying>

visualMeditations.title: <e.g. The Paralyzed Law>
visualMeditations.meaning: <what it meant then, what it reveals>

sections.heading: <e.g. The Dilemma of Theodicy>
paragraphs: <honest treatment of the chapter's central theological issue>

ntConnection.heading: New Testament Connection
paragraphs: <a real, specific NT quotation/fulfillment of this chapter, traced concretely>

lexicon.strongs: <e.g. H2555 — must exist in the Strong's Hebrew dictionary>
lexicon.insight: <what the word literally means and how it unlocks the chapter>

items.title: <e.g. The Permission to Lament>
items.body: <turn the chapter on the reader personally, end in challenge questions>
